contexts.text: The habitations of good Spirits and Angels commonly have arcades, or long courts, arched, sometimes doubled, where are their walks. Described. SE 2160.
(Laurel arcades in the gardens there where little children walk.) HH 337.
These are compared to courts, and those which are outside and cohere with interior things, to porches.
Truths leading to good, and from good to truths, are signified by the porch, and the steps ().
He introduced them into a colonnade constructed of pillars and pyramids; in front there was a low palace, through which the entrance into the colonnade opened...
Sitting in the porches of the houses.
Lo! there was seen an arcade of palms and laurels, along which we advanced; the arcade wound in a circuit, and terminated in a garden.
Lo! at the foot of the hill there was an arcade of palms, that was continued to its very summit; we entered and ascended. TCR 48.
I saw afar off a grove, in the midst of which there was an arcade leading towards a small palace.
(Arcades formed of trees in Jupiter, Described.)
The porch (of the Temple) = those things which are of the Ultimate Heaven, and which support the two higher Heavens.
The porch, and court (of the Temple) = all things that are without the Church, but that still regard it, which are all things that, with the man of the Church, are in his natural man.
